book.name: 2 TESALONÁIKA
book.title: 2 Tesalonáika Yeisu ana totugugunayao Tesalonáika goiadi leta aiyuwoina

content: Awanoi kidi Paulo manudi
Semao, kokaawanōi manuma bego kai itoboinema ida Tomoya Valena katagaegae go, tomota sinove, bei sikilagasi be sinumise nakae komi boi konumise.
Aiyuwoina kokaawanōi bego tomota toogoyoidi goi Yaubada iiyavema. Bogina kooyagoi. Tomota badabadaidi geya idi numisamo, tauna idi sinapu sigoyo yaima.
Go ida Tomoya aba numisa, tauna bei ikitoogagemi be nakae ivabodeebodemi Togoyoinayana yaina goi.
Ago ida Tomoya yaina kanumisa komi manumi bego kaga kaloviinaemi ame tuta be nakae tuta simamaima bei koguuinuwedi.
Kakawanoi Yaubada yaina bego ida Tomoya nuwomi ivaakededi, e bei komaatakoi nakae Yaubada imaatakoi be nakae kotaoyaakavata nakae boi Guyau itaoyakavata tutayana tomota siyogeedegede.
Lovina suumoyaidi manudi
E ida Tomoya Yeisu Guyau yoina goi kalovinaemi bego avatau neta suumoyaina be nakae vatulúkwana boi kavatuulukoimi geya isabokuliyeyeta, e tauyana kovasiyaasiyāe.
Moitamo. Boi kai yaimi goi kakaaiyaka geya suumoyaima geya, go sem kai topoisógana. Tauna komi bogina kooyagoi manakaemi itoboinemi ima sinapu kovatotowone.
Toinima avama manuna kaeemaisimi. Geya tayaamo kaga komi yaimi kakaabibeso, go sem mama poisógana be mama valitulítuwo sabamgo be maliyalina goi kapaaisewa, govila bei ami yogala kayato.
Kai mama lovina itoboinema bei awoinu goi kovaaitema go, ame nakae geya latuwoma, go sem latuwoma toinima kapaaisewa bego kai imi kaba gita tayamo, e itoboinemi kovatotoowonema.
Ame moitamo. Kai boi tutayana kakaaiyaka yaimi nakae, ame lovinayana kavinimi kama, ‘Avatau neta geya ipaiseweta, e nakae tauyana áika geya.’
Lovinayana unana valemi bogina kanove bego maniyemi suumoyaimi, nakae paisewa geya, geya toina, go sem koketooiya beso tomota idi paisewa goi koyoobosedi. Tauna lovinayana kavinimneimi.
Avatauwa yaimi neta imi sinapu nakae, e ida Tomoya Yeisu Guyau yoina goi kalovinaemi be nakae kakatuliwolemi mami tuwowonuwa kopaaisēwa toinimi avami manuna.
E komi go semaoyami guinuwa dedevina manuna taabu kokawoowokāi.
E avatau neta ima vatulukwanayana leta ame goi geya isabokuliyeyeta, tauyana imi tugúguna goi yoina kotalavāite bei koyagoi go, kovasiyaasiyāe bego kogieomaemae.
Ago tauyana taabu kovaakalēye, go sem koliwoleyāmo unana tauyana siyami.
Paulo ina vaduduwo
E ida Tomoya, Tauyana tuboina unana, tuta liliuna imi kaiyaka madabokina goi tuboina bei iivinimi. Ida Tomoya komi liliumi taiyao!
Yau Paulo vaduduwo ame toinigu nimagu goi agini. Ame aba kinana guna leta liliudi goi bei koyagoi leta ame yau agini. Ame guna sinapu leta ana gínina manuna.
Ida Tomoya Yeisu Guyau ina kanuwóiya bei ikaaiyaka komi liliumi yaimi.
Yau Paulo, Silovano be Timoti
